data.one_liner: Scrape HTML content from websites with a simple, cross‑platform API
data.what_it_does: Chaleno fetches a web page and parses its HTML, exposing methods to query elements by id, class, tag, or CSS selector. It returns text, src, or href attributes directly.
use_when: Need quick, lightweight web scraping in a Flutter app
Want a single dependency that works on mobile, desktop, and web
Prefer a straightforward imperative API over complex streams
avoid_when: Working with large or dynamic pages that require JavaScript execution
Need advanced parsing, filtering, or data extraction pipelines
Relying on a maintained, feature‑rich library is critical
strengths: Simple, readable API for common scraping tasks
weaknesses: Limited feature set (no advanced selectors or async streams)
